page.overview:
Who is Benny Brakedrum?

Benny Brakedrum is a minor character in Cars.

"Benny Brakedrum had never been to a race before - that is until he was caller #7 to his favorite radio show, "Mornings with Eddy and the Dump Truck!" And just like that he had two front row tickets to the biggest event of the decade, as long as he wears his free "Eddy and the Dump Truck" bumper sticker that is."
